description: Use the Salesforce Tooling API under /services/data/v{version}/tooling on the registered org. Operations: query (GET /tooling/query; query q is SOQL over Tooling types), query_more (GET the nextRecordsUrl given as next_records_url), search (GET /tooling/search; q is SOSL), execute_anonymous (GET /tooling/executeAnonymous; query anonymousBody is the Apex to run), run_tests_async (POST /tooling/runTestsAsynchronous; body classids, suiteids, tests, testLevel, maxFailedTests or skipCodeCoverage), run_tests_sync (POST /tooling/runTestsSynchronous; body tests), completions (GET /tooling/completions; type apex or visualforce), list_sobjects (GET /tooling/sobjects), sobject_info (GET /tooling/sobjects/{sobject}; basic information and recentItems), describe (GET /tooling/sobjects/{sobject}/describe), create (POST /tooling/sobjects/{sobject}; body fields), get (GET /tooling/sobjects/{sobject}/{id}; optional fields), update (PATCH /tooling/sobjects/{sobject}/{id}; body fields) and delete (DELETE /tooling/sobjects/{sobject}/{id}). Salesforce permissions alone decide each operation, including Apex execution and deletes. Returns job_id/status queued.
embedding_description: Work with Salesforce developer metadata through the Tooling API: query ApexClass, ApexTrigger, TraceFlag and other Tooling objects, run anonymous Apex, start Apex test runs, get code completions, and create, update or delete Tooling records. Use for debugging, deployment checks and test execution; org permissions decide.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued dispatch: job_id and status. Completion: family, operation, method, status (HTTP), selected headers, body (query records with done and nextRecordsUrl, search results, ExecuteAnonymousResult with compiled, success, line, column, compileProblem, exceptionMessage and exceptionStackTrace, a test run job id, RunTestsResult, describe metadata or a SaveResult), correlation_id, error_code for a 4xx/5xx or unknown status, failures (1 when anonymous Apex failed to compile or run, or a save reported success false) and pagination.next_records_url for query_more.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Anonymous Apex and Tooling writes can change org state and data. Report compiled, success, compileProblem and exceptionMessage exactly; a 200 with success false is a failed Apex run. Queued means only that the job was accepted. Offer next_records_url as a query_more call; it is never followed automatically.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Call the Salesforce Tooling API with the registered user's permissions.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params is raised before any vendor call when the operation, Tooling sObject API name, record id, next_records_url (must be a Tooling query locator path), documented query parameters (q, anonymousBody, type apex or visualforce, fields) or a required body do not match the vendor shape. Vendor HTTP errors are completion data with error_code: sf.malformed_query (MALFORMED_QUERY, INVALID_FIELD, INVALID_TYPE), sf.bad_request (400), sf.session_expired or sf.auth_failed (401), sf.permission_denied (403), sf.not_found (404), sf.api_error otherwise.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read the status and body before retrying. A permission error means the registered user lacks Author Apex, View All Data or the object permission in Salesforce; grant it there. For a compile failure fix the Apex at the reported line and column. Never re-run anonymous Apex automatically after a transport error: check its effect first.
